title: ISC — Lead Nurture Sequence
description: Triggers when ISC fires a lead.captured webhook. Sends a personalised intro email immediately, then after a 48-hour delay sends a discovery call invitation. Payload fields are nested under 'data': data.name, data.email, data.company, data.industry.

settings.note: Copy the generated Catch Hook URL and paste it into ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'lead.captured'.

settings.subject: Welcome to I Supply Chain — let's get started
settings.body:
Hi {{1__data__name}},

Thank you for reaching out to I Supply Chain. We have reviewed your submission and are excited to help you optimise your supply chain.

Over the next 48 hours we will send you some useful resources and would love to schedule a short discovery call.

→ Book a 20-minute discovery call

If you have any questions, simply reply to this email.


Best regards,
The I Supply Chain Team
YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN
settings.note: Connect your Gmail account. Replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN and YOUR_CALENDAR_LINK. {{1__data__email}} and {{1__data__name}} map to the nested data.email and data.name fields.
Pauses the Zap for 48 hours before sending the follow-up. Adjust as needed.

settings.subject: Ready for a quick discovery call? — I Supply Chain
settings.body:
Hi {{1__data__name}},

Following up on your enquiry — we would love to schedule a short call to understand your supply-chain goals and show you how ISC can help.

→ Pick a time that works for you

Looking forward to speaking soon.


Best,
The I Supply Chain Team
settings.note: Replace YOUR_CALENDAR_LINK. Sent 48 hours after the welcome email.

setupSteps: 1. In Zapier, create a new Zap. Choose 'Webhooks by Zapier' as the trigger with event 'Catch Hook'.
2. Copy the Catch Hook URL and register it in ISC → Admin → Integration Hub → Webhooks with event 'lead.captured'.
3. Add a Gmail action (step 2). Connect your account, set To = {{1__data__email}}, and replace YOUR_ISC_DOMAIN and YOUR_CALENDAR_LINK.
4. Add a 'Delay by Zapier → Delay For 48 hours' step.
5. Add a second Gmail action (step 4). Set To = {{1__data__email}} and replace YOUR_CALENDAR_LINK.

6. All lead fields (name, email, company, industry) are nested under 'data' in the payload — use {{1__data__name}}, {{1__data__email}} etc. (Zapier flattens nested objects automatically when you map using the sample payload.)
